scope: G034 calibration plot source-independent in-host floating snapshots, shared immutable payload admission and independent view controls

implementation.payload: One shared immutable calibration plot/annotation payload and one retained render-memory lease per distinct data set; no source document/provider/transaction pointer. Each window has its own view, drag, focus and controller lease.
implementation.publication: All three live plot publication routes admit retained data before image commit/controller swap. Quota refusal preserves previous calibration, undo history and plot. Source mutation invalidates live plots only; closing source immediately clears live payload.
implementation.lifecycle: Keep snapshot / Duplicate snapshot retain prepared data without copying sample vectors. Snapshots survive source mutation and closure. Axes, pan/zoom/rectangle, details and CSV reuse one renderer. Last owner releases managed payload; no second producer store or worker pool.
implementation.identity: Monotonic public snapshot/payload IDs; internal ImGui slots reused by peak concurrency with scoped logical control IDs, cleared storage/input, no saved settings. Dialog callbacks resolve logical ID+generation; stale IDs cannot retarget replacement windows.
implementation.focus: Latest explicit keep/live publication focus wins; snapshot appearance alone cannot steal it.
implementation.python: Editor.plot_snapshots_info returns small identity/memory summaries. keep_plot_snapshot optionally duplicates plot_id; close_plot_snapshot requires positive ID. Existing show_intensity_plot_limits, set_intensity_plot_limits and zoom_intensity_plot_rectangle accept optional plot_id; omitted/zero selects guarded live plot. Snapshot actions work without source documents.
implementation.memory_scope: Managed retained sample/annotation/controller allocations only; excludes total RSS, ImGui/driver/transport transient allocations and caller JSON objects.
implementation.window_scope: Floating inside main application only, session lifetime; independent OS windows require backend platform-window implementation and OS/GPU qualification. No snapshot workspace persistence.

verification.native: Windows projection execution/private viewport+annotation+payload checks pass. Linux C++17 private consumer linked to existing core SDK archive passes; not Linux UI/full SDK qualification.
verification.actual_imgui_input: Four installed C++ cases; snapshot workflow also through Python. Actual Keep/Duplicate, independent numeric axes after source closure, CSV export after closure and close controls. Source mutation/closure are labeled fixtures; independent reader checks old samples/unit/views, owner weak reference expiration, memory deltas and final managed bytes zero.
verification.regressions: Live replacement keeps old snapshot, render quota refusal precedes metadata/history commit, strict IDs, monotonic IDs through slot reuse, shared data charged once and released at last owner.
verification.limits: Focused installed/headless checks do not prove full ImageJ/Fiji parity, OS/GPU behavior or comparative speed.

harness_history.cause: One of753 tests exposed appearance focus stealing a newly published live plot in a fresh UI context. Explicit focus priority fixed;753 pass in346 and348. Failed source delta against89308c3 preserved and original source SHA checked against build341 freeze.
ZIP members use POSIX separators; Windows member lookup corrected. Existing archive reused and all member hashes verified before any retirement.

storage.retention: All packet-owned Windows/Linux terminal scratch retired. Necessary captures/logs/producer manifests/failed delta compressed and hash-verified. Same compiler caches and installed runtimes/SDKs; no whole cache or checkout archive. Historical inventories retain original scopes.
